suggestions: pre-filter a large table as a CTE before the join
reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
optimized_sql:
SELECT count(*)
FROM store_sales
JOIN time_dim
  ON ss_sold_time_sk = time_dim.t_time_sk
JOIN household_demographics
  ON ss_hdemo_sk = household_demographics.hd_demo_sk
 AND household_demographics.hd_dep_count = 0
JOIN store
  ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
WHERE time_dim.t_hour = 8
  AND time_dim.t_minute >= 30
  AND store.s_store_name = 'ese'
ORDER BY count(*)
LIMIT 100
